title: Common definitions
description: Shared primitive types for coqui-agent-spec. Normative.

Id.description: Opaque, unique, stable identifier. Reference impls SHOULD use ULID/UUIDv7.

Timestamp.description: RFC-3339 UTC, Z-suffixed. The pattern enforces UTC even where format-assertion is off.

NullableTimestamp.description: A Timestamp or null. Nullable timestamp fields MUST use this so a non-Z offset is rejected uniformly (same UTC-Z rule as Timestamp).

Slug.description: Lowercase kebab/snake identifier used for definition and memory names.

ModelId.description: Implementation-defined model identifier, echoed verbatim across the API.

TokenizerHint.description: Hint for cross-provider token counting when W is needed (Budgeting.md).
